about_the_game: The music of File 47, composed by Dux, creates an unsettling and oppressive atmosphere, combining ambient sounds, distortions, and minimalist melodies to intensify the feeling of psychological horror. The soundtrack features dynamic pieces that evolve based on the protagonist's mental state, along with audio effects designed to generate constant tension. One standout composition is The Descent Into Madness, a 14-minute piece that merges the main themes of the game.

name: File 47 Soundtrack
short_description: The File 47 OST, composed by Dux, blends unsettling atmospheres and dissonant melodies to immerse the player in psychological horror. Each track intensifies the dark, disturbing atmosphere of the game.
